name: corelift
description: Connect your SAP system and let agents lift custom ABAP apps to clean core: read-only discovery, pinned SAP API evidence, assessment and drafted ABAP Cloud/BTP target code.

sap_url.title: SAP system URL
sap_url.description: https://host:port of your SAP system (ADT services). Leave empty to connect later with `corelift connect`, or type demo for a fictional system.

sap_client.title: SAP client
sap_client.description: Client (Mandant), e.g. 100. Empty uses the system default.

sap_user.title: SAP user
sap_user.description: User with ADT display authorization (S_ADT_RES, S_DEVELOP activity 03).

sap_password.title: SAP password
sap_password.description: Stored in your OS credential store; never shown to the agent.
